title: Curious by nature. A developer by practice.
paragraphs: I’m Muhammed Ajlan V, a BCA graduate and Flutter developer at Triasoft Softwares.

My journey includes a three-month Angular internship and ongoing work in mobile development. I enjoy understanding how an interface works, improving the small details, and learning through practical problems.
